overview: The School Committee recognized the retirement of the Director of Student Services and approved the schematic design for the Roberts School HVAC electrification project. The body also reallocated capital funds for immediate maintenance needs and passed resolutions regarding e-bike safety and federal broadband funding.

items.title: Consent Agenda
items.summary: Approved the consent agenda, including a $35,000 donation for CCSR and the July 20th minutes as amended to reflect specific sustainability goals.

items.title: Recognition: Joan Bowen Retirement
items.summary: Recognized Joan Bowen, Director of Student Services, for 33 years of service to the district upon her retirement.

items.title: MPS Wellness Policy
items.summary: Approved the updated Wellness Policy, which aligns district standards for nutrition, physical activity, and social-emotional well-being with state requirements. The committee waived the second reading to finalize the policy.

items.title: Roberts HVAC Schematic Design Approval
items.summary: Approved the $22.7 million schematic design for the Roberts School roof replacement and HVAC electrification project for submission to the MSBA. The project includes heat pump installation, solar array preparation, and necessary accessibility upgrades.

items.title: Fiscal Year 27 Capital Projects Adjustments
items.summary: Reallocated $210,000 in surplus capital funds to intercom systems at three schools and redirected $250,000 from a canceled tank project to urgent repairs including drainage, turf, and chillers.

items.title: Resolution 2026-06: Committee Rules Update
items.summary: Approved updated School Committee rules reflecting edits discussed during June meetings.

items.title: Resolution 2026-20: Assessment Landscape Report
items.summary: Approved a resolution for the Curriculum and Instruction subcommittee to meet with administration to review a report on standardized assessment frequency and its impact on instructional time.

items.title: Resolution 2026-21: E-Bike Safety Education
items.summary: Approved providing educational materials regarding laws and safety practices for e-bikes and micromobility devices to students and staff within the first month of school.

items.title: Resolution 2026-22: MCHS Building Committee Updates
items.summary: Appointed several new voting and non-voting members to the Medford Comprehensive High School Building Committee for terms ending June 30, 2027.

items.title: Resolution 2026-23: E-Rate Program Support
items.summary: Approved a resolution urging the FCC to preserve and fully fund the E-Rate program, which provides the district with approximately $278,000 in annual discounts for broadband internet.
